# orchestration_install_tool

> List or install pre-built orchestration pipeline packages, and manage the lifecycle of ANY template (packaged or custom/builder-authored) by its template_id.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `orchestration` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=orchestration_install_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

List or install pre-built orchestration pipeline packages, and manage the
lifecycle of ANY template (packaged or custom/builder-authored) by its
template_id.

Actions:
- "list": Show available pipeline packages with descriptions and stage summaries.
- "install": Install a pipeline package for your tenant. Creates all agents,
  role types, and the pipeline template. Optionally override the default model
  for all agents in the package.
- "uninstall": Remove an installed CATALOG pipeline (by package_id) — destroys
  its template + run history and removes the agents it provisioned that no
  other installed pipeline still uses (shared agents are kept). Refuses while
  a run is active.
- "activate" / "deactivate": Flip a template's `active` flag by template_id.
  Works on packaged and custom templates alike. A deactivated template
  refuses every start (manual start, schedule, named track) but keeps its
  run history. "deactivate" also clears the stored schedule_cron by default
  (clear_schedule: false to keep it) so reactivating later doesn't
  immediately resume firing on a stale schedule.
- "delete": Hard-delete a CUSTOM (non-catalog) template by template_id —
  destroys its run history, stages, and transitions. Refuses while a run is
  active, and refuses on an installed catalog package (use "uninstall" for
  those instead, so provisioned agents get cleaned up too). Provisioned
  agents are NOT touched by this action.

Packages are idempotent — reinstalling updates existing agents and replaces
the template. Safe to run multiple times.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | string | yes | Action to perform. One of: `list`, `install`, `uninstall`, `activate`, `deactivate`, `delete`. |
| `package_id` | string | no | Package ID to install/uninstall (required for those actions). Use "list" to see IDs. |
| `template_id` | integer | no | OrchestrationTemplate ID (required for activate/deactivate/delete). Works on any template you own, packaged or custom. |
| `model_override` | string | no | Optional: LLM model internal_identifier to use for all agents (e.g., "sonnet", "haiku", "gpt-4o"). If omitted, uses package defaults. |
| `clear_schedule` | boolean | no | For "deactivate" only: also clear custom_fields.schedule_cron. Defaults to true. |
